newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: 19 killed, 12 injured in Ethiopia bus crash.
newsitem.headline: 19 killed, 12 injured in Ethiopia bus crash.

text.p: Nineteen people were killed and 12 others injured when a bus in which they were travelling crashed into a ravine in northern Ethiopia, the state news agency ENA reported on Wednesday.
Police said the bus driver was among the dead in the accident on Tuesday, whose cause was still under investigation, the news agency added.
